# Bang Motion Upstream

- Repository: https://github.com/bangtutorial/bang-motion
- Pinned commit: `0f1bd1103835890354496d009af62885fe0a05d5`
- License: MIT
- Copyright: Copyright (c) 2026 Bang Tutorial

Auno Studio uses Bang Motion as a motion-design reference and provenance source for selected deterministic timing, camera choreography, anti-slide, kinetic typography, layered-background, transition, and visual-storytelling principles.

Production runtime code lives in Auno-owned modules such as `packages/auno-motion/` and OpenPost-native editor adapters. Auno Studio does not use Bang Motion's standalone HTML deliverable as its project format and does not pre-render Auto Video scenes to MP4 merely to make them editable.

When additional Bang Motion source is copied or substantially derived, preserve the MIT notice in `licenses/bang-motion/LICENSE` and record the source file/revision here or in the third-party inventory.
